question: Which 1P1C payload sizes change the ranking?

why: rust: first place crossbeam-queue -> std-mpsc and time ×282.37

recommendation.rule: Keep 256 B as the default small cell. Add one larger cell only when some language becomes copy-bound (handoff at least 2× and the pack collapses to about 1.3×) or the ranking inverts. Mid-pack swaps with a flat time scale are not a new size. A later inversion after the first copy-cost knee stays a research / experiment cell, not a third default type.
